subject: physics

hotspots.label: Displacement Arrow
hotspots.description: The single net arrow from the start dot to the target dot — it carries both a size and a direction.
hotspots.positionHint: A straight arrow spanning start to finish across the grid.
hotspots.function: Shows the net straight-line result of a journey, magnitude and direction together.

hotspots.label: Initial Position
hotspots.description: Where the journey begins — the tail end of the displacement arrow.
hotspots.positionHint: A blue dot near one corner of the grid.
hotspots.function: Marks the initial position displacement is measured between.

hotspots.label: Final Position
hotspots.description: Where the journey ends — the head of the displacement arrow.
hotspots.positionHint: A coral dot near the opposite corner of the grid.
hotspots.function: Marks the final position the displacement arrow reaches.

hotspots.label: Zero Displacement
hotspots.description: Set start and final position on the same dot and the arrow shrinks to nothing — zero displacement even after a long trek.
hotspots.positionHint: A small badge shown when both dots overlap.
hotspots.function: Demonstrates that returning to the start yields zero net displacement.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A flat warm-grey grid mat (xz plane), a blue start dot, a coral target dot, a single coral straight displacement arrow, plus dotted leg arrows and a faint grey dotted detour path. Saturated color only on the arrow and hotspots. Soft neutral studio light, no emissive, no bloom.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Grid mat warm-grey speckled (roughness ~0.7), dots are small smooth spheres (roughness ~0.3), displacement arrow a polished soda-coral prism (roughness ~0.35, metallic=0), leg arrows warm white dotted. Dotted path dashed greys. Live readout text is an app-layer overlay.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: displacement as the net vector between an initial and a final position, with tip-to-tail vector addition.

GEOMETRY: a flat world-axis grid mat on y=0 (say 4.0 × 3.0). An orange displacement arrow sits on the mat from Start to Target, drawn as a low prism with a cone head. A chain of grey leg-arrows (2–4) can fade in, laid tip-to-tail, ending at the same target to show the legs merging into the net. A dashed grey route winding around illustrates ignored distance.

INTERACTION: 1) drag the Start dot anywhere on the mat — the arrow redraws as the direct new connect; 2) a <Journey Components> toggles showing the leg arrows and their tip-to-tail sum; 3) a Quick Zero preset overlaps Target on Start.

NAMES: GridMat, StartDot, TargetDot, DisplacementArrow, Leg1/2/3, RouteDashed, ReadoutBadge. Budget 6-9k triangles.
